scope: Read-only public official installation source review; no downloaded installer or Agent was executed. Implementation and synthetic fixtures are separate evidence; no Windows runtime/Agent acceptance claimed.

facts: The official PowerShell installer selects windows-x64, documenting x64 emulation on ARM64.
Farfold follows that public native binary route; it does not execute the installer or guess platform asset names.
Main package uses npm-loader.js and declares win32-x64 and win32-arm64 optional platform packages at the same version.
Observed x64 and arm64 platform manifests declare os win32, matching cpu, exports . -> ./copilot.exe.
Authentication supplement still requires the exact reviewed package/managed receipt and live official declaration; this is not an installation version pin.
CREATE_NO_WINDOW applies only to the process being created; a GUI helper alone does not prove its selected console program will avoid a new window.
Farfold helper receives an explicit stdio/pty mode. Background selected command uses CREATE_NO_WINDOW; terminal selected command preserves the attached ConPTY.
The standalone generated Node launcher inherits an existing console; with no console it applies CREATE_NO_WINDOW to selected Node. Actual Windows behavior remains untested on this Mac.
TerminateJobObject acts on currently associated processes, so the helper before Job entry is also retained and terminated by exact process handle.

attach is called while the original std/async/PTY Child still retains its Windows process handle; Windows keeps that process ID allocated until all handles are closed, making the immediate OpenProcess lookup refer to that same object.
A synthetic-only barrier fixture covers cancel before helper Job entry. This test is added but has not been executed on Windows.

limitations: Node forwarding template was cross-compiled to PE; no Windows execution yet.
Installation-appended paths affect Authenticode; signing/distribution is not validated.
Windows tar.bz2 extraction is not yet implemented; must remain unadvertised as installable unless another official supported route exists.
